components.name: HealthScores.ai wallet
components.notes: To load other patients you will need to download a PDF from https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/15AnauX24MuGOyJ9f3-V7Yq2HAKOjUwMX and open it into https://qa.healthscores.ai/r/sprz/ and click Learn.  Then the new patient will be in the switch to list the next time the wallet loads.
components.description: A patient or caregiver's health app: US Core records, documents with their files, and forms, for the person or someone they care for, shared item by item and record by record. Renders questionnaires and pre-populates them from data already available from scores.  Observations can also come from Apple and Google Health data.
